description: Why: the inline LEB128 parser in tests/car_export.rs is a re-implementation of logic already in car_writer.rs. Divergence between the two will cause test false-negatives (the test passes even when the encoder is wrong, because the decoder has the same bug). What: tests/car_export.rs defines decode_varint and parse_blocks inline. The test oracle should be an independent reference (ipld.io spec or a third-party CAR decoder), not a hand-rolled copy of the production encoder's inverse. Using a published ipld-car crate for decoding in tests would provide a genuine independent oracle.
title: car_export test inlines CAR varint/block parsing instead of calling car_writer helpers
